reviewFlags.issue: The catalog gives a power range of 1820-2180W. No fetched page for SDF300 states a power value. The only power figure found (1800W) belongs to sibling model DF4100 and was not used.

Only one page that names SDF300 was fetched (Zap comparison page, kind other). Its listings mention an official importer, but no named importer was found. The Home Center page that also names the model returned HTTP 429. Facts from this single site will go to review, not publish.
Catalog states 1820-2180W but no source for SDF300 states a power value; not published, needs a manufacturer or importer source.

All evidence comes from comparison-site pages (Zap and its Wisebuy mirror) whose text matches the catalog wording closely; no manufacturer, importer or manual source was found. Israeli importer unknown.
Catalog says the oil container is removable; sources only say it has a non-stick coating.
